title: Query-log delivery and gate speed: a store check in seconds, one bad entry holds back one file, no fixture rows in the spool
goal: querylog.py check scans each distinct value of a store file once and finishes on the committed store in under 60 seconds; a store file that fails the leak scan stays local while the other files of the batch are delivered; a kb/public change that stops the store passing its gates is refused at the sync gate; a probe run in a temporary clone writes no ops row to a real spool; kbmon's cleanup panel and backlog.py tidy read git state with a fixed number of git processes; a backlog check's benchmark sandboxes are removed with its run; backlog.py in the kb's own checkout starts one git process to find its root

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
